title: iannuttall/seo CLI and MCP for local SEO audits
summary: Apache-licensed npm CLI (seoskill.dev) that runs technical SEO audits, Search Console and GA4 reports, competitor research, and IndexNow submission from your machine, with MCP install for Cursor and CI-friendly JSON exports.
question_it_answers: How do I run agent-accessible SEO audits on my own crawl and Google data?

claims.text: The repo provides a local CLI and MCP server for SEO audits using your crawl, Search Console, and GA4.
claims.evidence: Audit sites, find search opportunities, research competitors, and verify work from one local CLI and MCP server — using your own crawl, Search Console, and GA4 data.
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

claims.text: MCP tools install into Cursor via seo mcp install.
claims.evidence: `seo mcp install` exposes tools to Cursor and other MCP clients
